'''Joan Cervós Moro''' (born 24 February 1998) is an Andorran professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Defender (association football)#Full-back|left-back]] for [[Tercera Federación]] side [[CP San Cristóbal|San Cristóbal]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.worldfootball.net/person/pe406456/joan-cervos/ |title=Joan Cervós |website=worldfootball.net |publisher=HEIM:SPIEL |access-date=6 September 2018}}</ref>

==Club career==
===Colorado Springs Switchbacks===
In January 2020, Cervós joined [[USL Championship]] club [[Colorado Springs Switchbacks FC]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://gazette.com/sports/andorran-defender-joan-cerv-s-joins-colorado-springs-switchbacks/article_d3782e4a-31a0-11ea-990e-8341e32fe6ee.html|title=Andorran defender Joan Cervós joins Colorado Springs Switchbacks|website=gazette.com|date=7 January 2020|access-date=5 May 2020}}</ref> He made his league debut for the club in the opening match of the season, playing the entirety of a 2–1 away victory over [[OKC Energy FC]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/matches/2020/03/08/united-states/mls-reserve-league/okc-energy/colorado-springs/3204661/|title=OKC Energy vs. Colorado Springs – 8 March 2020 – Soccerway|website=int.soccerway.com|access-date=5 May 2020}}</ref>

==International career==
Cervós made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] on 3 June 2018 in a friendly match against [[Cape Verde national football team|Cape Verde]]. Cervós started the match before coming off in the 90+4th minute for [[Jordi Rubio]], with the match finishing as a 2–4 loss on [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalties]] following a 0–0 draw.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://int.soccerway.com/matches/2018/06/03/world/friendlies/andorra/cape-verde-islands/2789321/ |title=Andorra vs. Cape Verde Islands – 3 June 2018 |website=Soccerway |publisher=[[Perform Group]] |date=3 June 2018 |access-date=6 September 2018}}</ref>
